summary.text: Boomer Wright is a Republican member of the Oregon House of Representatives for House District 9, which his legislative page associates with Coos Bay.
His biography describes a career in education, as a teacher, principal and school superintendent, before he became general manager of Sea Lion Caves.

paragraphs.text: Representative Wright grew up in Lorane, Oregon, after moving from California at age 10, and his biography says he graduated from Crow High School.
He received a bachelor's degree in education from Oregon College of Education in 1972 and began his first teaching job at Siuslaw Elementary in Florence that year.
He completed a master's degree in education and administrator certification at the University of Oregon in 1982.

Wright served as vice principal of Siuslaw Middle School in 1981-1982, principal of Rhododendron Elementary from 1982 to 1988, principal of Siuslaw Middle School from 1988 to 1994 and principal of Siuslaw Primary from 1994 to 1999.
He was superintendent of the Mapleton School District from 1999 to 2002.
After retiring from education in 2002, he worked for Selco Credit Union as its liaison for the Florence community for three years, and then served as general manager of Sea Lion Caves for five years.
His biography says he has since substitute taught at high schools in House District 9.
Wright lives in Reedsport, Oregon, with his wife, Susan, according to his biography, which also says he has two children, Susan has two children, and the couple have seven grandchildren.
